This is not the finalized Terms of Use. Contact, age, governing law and subscription offers remain under review; do not publish this draft as binding terms.

1. About Cubyfit

Cubyfit is a fitness and personal-growth application developed and operated by Mohamed Radouan, Marouan Younsi and Mouad Mezian in Casablanca, Morocco. These Terms govern your use of the Cubyfit mobile application, website and related services.

By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these Terms, subject to any additional acceptance requirements imposed by applicable law. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

2. What Cubyfit Offers

Cubyfit provides tools for building routines and supporting personal consistency, including habit tracking, workouts, nutrition logging, progress monitoring, reminders and motivational content.

The app provides free features and optional Cubyfit Pro subscriptions. Some features may require internet access, supported devices or a premium subscription.

3. Account Responsibilities

You agree to provide accurate account information, use the service lawfully and take reasonable steps to protect your account. Do not access other users' records, attempt to bypass security or subscription restrictions, or interfere with the service.

Before publication: The minimum account age and any age verification or parental consent arrangements must be finalized.

4. Health and Fitness Disclaimer

Cubyfit provides general fitness, nutrition, habit and wellness tracking tools. Cubyfit is not a medical service and does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment or individualized medical advice.

Calorie estimates, fitness targets, nutritional information and similar calculations are approximate. Individual needs vary. Exercise and nutrition decisions should take your circumstances into account. Seek advice from a qualified healthcare professional when appropriate. Cubyfit does not guarantee specific health, weight-loss, muscle-gain or personal-development results.

5. Personal Records and Content

You retain your rights in original information you provide. Cubyfit processes your records to deliver the features you request, including optional cloud backup where enabled.

You are responsible for the accuracy of information you enter. Third-party food and exercise information may contain errors or be subject to separate licenses.

6. Cubyfit Pro

Cubyfit may offer monthly and annual subscriptions. The intended standard pricing is USD $5.99 monthly and USD $59.99 annually. Eligible annual subscriptions may include a 14-day trial. These are intended offers, not a promise of the same currency, price, promotion or trial for every user. The actual store checkout shows the applicable price, billing period, available trial and taxes.

Pro benefits are those displayed in the app and relevant subscription offer. RevenueCat and the applicable store manage entitlement status. Before publication: Verify the actual products, trial eligibility, displayed benefits and prices in each store.

7. Trials, Renewals and Cancellation

Subscriptions may renew automatically unless cancelled through the relevant app store. If a free trial is offered and you qualify, it may become paid at the end of the trial unless you cancel within the required period. Review the checkout terms.

Manage subscriptions through Google Play or Apple. Uninstalling Cubyfit or deleting your account does not automatically cancel billing. Refund requests follow applicable store rules and mandatory consumer-protection law.

8. Advertising

Free accounts may display Google AdMob advertisements. Eligible Cubyfit Pro accounts are intended to receive an ad-free experience while the entitlement is active. Advertising practices and privacy choices are described in the Privacy Policy.

9. Local Data and Cloud Backup

Cubyfit saves supported fitness information locally and offers optional cloud backup. Synchronization and restoration depend on connectivity, authentication, service availability and supported synchronization behavior. Not every local change can be guaranteed recoverable, particularly during unresolved conflicts, device loss or interrupted synchronization.

10. Intellectual Property

Cubyfit's original software, interface, branding and content remain the property of their respective rights holders. Third-party materials remain subject to their own licenses and attribution requirements. Using the service does not grant ownership of Cubyfit's intellectual property.

11. Account Deletion

You can request irreversible account deletion through the app. The process removes supported account-owned records from Cubyfit's active systems, subject to the technical and legal retention limitations in the Privacy Policy. Active store subscriptions must be cancelled separately. See the account-deletion page for details. The outside-app request channel on that page is pending verification.

12. Availability and Changes

We may maintain, update, temporarily interrupt or change features when reasonably necessary. We will respect applicable consumer rights and existing subscription obligations. We cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability or compatibility with every device.

13. Liability

We make reasonable efforts to provide useful and reliable functionality. To the extent permitted by law, Cubyfit is not responsible for fitness outcomes or inaccuracies caused by user-entered information or third-party reference data. Nothing in these Terms excludes mandatory consumer rights or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

14. Governing Law

Cubyfit is operated from Morocco. Moroccan law is the proposed governing law, subject to legal review and mandatory protections applicable to users elsewhere. Before publication: Finalize the legally appropriate governing-law and dispute-resolution clause.

15. Changes to These Terms

We may revise these Terms to reflect service or legal changes. Where legally required, we will provide notice or request renewed acceptance.
